purpose: Finds a card field by its ontology term, and reads its spelling, label and value set from the master.
namedChanges: **the host constant becomes the setting** (RuleGhsSettingUnit): the import `GILBVEDA_MASTER_ORIGIN` from `./stakeholderKinds` is `import { termOrigin } from "@kaigilb/gilbplatformcode-term-origin"`, and each of the four URLs that began `${GILBVEDA_MASTER_ORIGIN}` (source lines 48, 133, 158 and 178) begins `${termOrigin()}`, read when the URL is built, never when the module loads;

**the host literal in `termLabelOfIri` becomes the same setting**: the pattern `/^https:\/\/veda\.gilb\.com\/base\/t\/([A-Za-z0-9]+)$/` (source line 153) is `new RegExp(`^${escapeRegExp(termOrigin())}/base/t/([A-Za-z0-9]+)$`)`, built each call, with `escapeRegExp` as a new private function at the end of the file. On the origin the app used (`https://veda.gilb.com`) the two patterns match the same texts (measured over a scripted scenario against the source: same answers, same requests);
**a test seam** (new code, not in the source): `__resetTermSlotsForTest()` empties the four caches; the app has no call that forgets them;
lines 1-37 of the source are not taken (`termName` and `fieldOfTerm`, which go to a later unit; no taken line calls either); the file's header comment is a new, shorter one;

comments only otherwise: cycle and step tags, person names, agent names, app names and one specification-clause number are removed or reworded, and one host name in a comment is `<origin>`; no code changed. No string literal carried a tag.
